item.description: The Memory class is missing the data property that should return a MemoryData object, causing AttributeError in test_elaborate.
item.contract: The Memory class must have a data property that returns a MemoryData object, accessible as m.data where m is a Memory instance.

item.description: Memory.Init class incorrectly handles MemoryData.Init objects and fails type checking for initialization values.
item.contract: The Memory.Init class must properly handle MemoryData.Init objects and validate initialization values according to the shape requirements.

item.description: Error message formatting inconsistencies in WritePort and ReadPort constructors for wrong parameter validation.
item.contract: Error messages for invalid parameters in WritePort and ReadPort constructors must match expected format exactly.

item.description: Memory.Init class needs proper handling of length constraints to prevent modification after instantiation.
item.contract: The Memory.Init class must enforce immutability of length and raise TypeError for deletion/insertion operations.

item.description: Memory constructor validation logic needs to correctly raise expected exceptions for invalid parameters.
item.contract: The Memory constructor must properly validate parameters and raise appropriate exceptions for invalid inputs like negative depths or wrong shapes.
